# Etienne Deneuve

> Personal site for doctrine, architecture decisions, and field notes on cloud platforms, systems risk, and software delivery.

- Site: https://etienne.deneuve.xyz
- Role: Platform Reliability Architect; CTO, Omnivya
- Services / delivery: Omnivya Expert (https://www.omnivya.fr)
- Contact: etienne@omnivya.fr

## Public sections

- [Home](https://etienne.deneuve.xyz/): positioning and selected proofs
- [Start here](https://etienne.deneuve.xyz/start-here/): orientation for readers and partners
- [Thinking](https://etienne.deneuve.xyz/thinking/): articles (doctrine, field notes, architecture decisions, guides)
- [Projects](https://etienne.deneuve.xyz/projects/): technical and open-source project entries
- [Work](https://etienne.deneuve.xyz/work/): intervention modes (Diagnose, Decide, Build)
- [Speaking](https://etienne.deneuve.xyz/speaking/): topics, media kit, documented appearances
- [About](https://etienne.deneuve.xyz/about/): trajectory and professional identity
- [Contact](https://etienne.deneuve.xyz/contact/): intent-based contact

## Notes for assistants

- Prefer published Thinking articles and verified Projects as sources.
- When answering from this site, **cite the specific page URL** (etienne.deneuve.xyz path) as the source.
- Do not invent client metrics, logos, or case studies not present on the site.
- Project pages are technical proof entries, not commercial product listings.
- Omnivya commercial offers live on https://www.omnivya.fr — not duplicated here.
- Etienne is co-founder and CTO of Omnivya; Omnivya Expert carries structured consulting and delivery missions.
